definitions: A cigarette that you roll yourself, especially one made with tobacco and rolling papers.
A type of pastry or food item that is made by rolling up a flat piece of dough or other ingredient.
An act of rolling something up.
A strategic acquisition of multiple smaller companies into a larger entity.
examples: He lit a roll-up and took a deep drag.
The kids loved the fruit roll-ups.
The company announced a major roll-up of regional competitors.
She prepared a spinach and cheese roll-up for lunch.
